provenance.source_title: Every Level of Investor — First $100 to First $1,000,000.

examples.psychological_goal: 重新定义失败的归因，让观众怀疑自己一直以来的解释框架
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定式归因转移 + 认知缺口
examples.example_text: They lose it in the gap between what they thought investing was and what it actually is.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"不是X，是X与Y之间的鸿沟"句式把失败重新归因到一个未被审视的地方
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该命题与"gap"措辞

examples.psychological_goal: 用系统冷漠击碎观众的个人化想象，建立冷静基调
examples.expression_mechanism: 系统冷漠拟人 + 元确认短句
examples.example_text: The market does not know you exist. That is not a metaphor.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先抛出拟人化冷漠断言，再用"这不是比喻"阻止观众把它当修辞
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制"市场不知道你存在"的原句

examples.psychological_goal: 打破平台制造的归属感幻觉，让观众意识到自己被界面取悦
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟人化设计意图 + 短句冷反转
examples.example_text: The welcome screen was designed to make you feel like you belong. You do not yet belong.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先陈述系统给你的感受，再用一句短否定撤回这份感受
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制欢迎界面这一具体场景

examples.psychological_goal: 用干幽默把羞耻的亏损经历变成可命名的共同记忆
examples.expression_mechanism: 概念变体列举 + 时代梗式自嘲
examples.example_text: Some people call it tuition. Some people call it their crypto phase.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"有人叫它A，有人叫它B"的变体列举交付幽默，同时完成概念普及
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制"crypto phase"这个具体梗

examples.psychological_goal: 反转观众对早期成功的直觉，制造全片最强认知冲击
examples.expression_mechanism: 先立事实 + 反直觉定性短句
examples.example_text: The strategy works two or three times. This is genuinely the worst thing that can happen.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先承认一个看似好消息的事实，再用最高级否定把它定性为危险
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该反转的具体语境

examples.psychological_goal: 把重建期的挫败感精确命名，让观众感到被深刻理解
examples.expression_mechanism: 平行句式 + 反常识比喻
examples.example_text: Rebuilding feels like standing still with extra steps.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X feels like Y"的结构，配一个违背直觉却精确的比喻

examples.psychological_goal: 把当前痛苦重新定义为未来资产，并把观众推向下一级
examples.expression_mechanism: 价值重估 + 前指钩子
examples.example_text: That data set is going to matter more than you think at the next level.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在章节结尾用"这将在下一级变得重要"的前指句完成软过渡
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制"data set"的具体指代

examples.psychological_goal: 把看似无关紧要的百分比差异换算成不可忽视的长期代价
examples.expression_mechanism: 完整算式铺陈 + 轻描淡写收尾
examples.example_text: The difference between 0.03% and 0.75% on $20,000, compounded annually over 20 years at 8% market returns, is not small.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把参数、期限、本金全部列清后，用"is not small"式克制反讽收尾
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制这组具体费率与参数

examples.psychological_goal: 让观众具体想象"复利点击"的瞬间，把抽象概念变成可期待的画面
examples.expression_mechanism: 第二人称具体时刻描述
examples.example_text: Your account has made more money this month from market movement than you deposited.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你的X本月从Y赚到的超过了你投入的Z"式可验证描述定义一个概念时刻
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该概念命名与描述

examples.psychological_goal: 解释为什么"等信号再回来"注定失败，强化持有的论证
examples.expression_mechanism: 拟人化否定 + 认知盲区陈述
examples.example_text: Market recoveries do not send announcements. They are only visible in retrospect.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"X不会发通知，只能在事后看见"的句式说明一类认知盲区
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制关于市场反弹的原句

examples.psychological_goal: 给观众一个稀缺的位置确认，交付地位奖励
examples.expression_mechanism: 相对位置量化 + 限定词克制
examples.example_text: You are in the top roughly 10% of American investors by account size.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"top roughly N%"加限定词给出地位事实，精确而不吹嘘
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该百分位与人群

examples.psychological_goal: 把重大变化的无仪式感本身变成悬念，引出结构跃迁
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定式悬念（没有通知、没有邮件）
examples.example_text: It is invisible because no one tells you when you cross it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用列举"不会发生什么的"排比来渲染一个安静但重大的变化
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制"隐形门槛"的具体指代

examples.psychological_goal: 宣告身份类别跃迁，把量变描述为质变
examples.expression_mechanism: 平行否定递进（not better → no longer）
examples.example_text: You are not a better retail investor. You are no longer a retail investor.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用"你不是更好的X，你不再是X"的递进否定宣告类别变化
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制该身份类别表述

examples.psychological_goal: 用首尾对照完成系统冷漠母题的收束，交付清醒的平静
examples.expression_mechanism: 时态对照 + 母题回归
examples.example_text: The market did not care about you then. It does not care about you now in any personal sense.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在结尾用"当时不在乎，现在也不在乎"的时态对照收束一个复发母题
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制系统冷漠母题的原句

examples.psychological_goal: 用一句短判词放弃控制幻觉，留下可复述的元原则
examples.expression_mechanism: 同词复沓 + 时态跳进（is not → was never）
examples.example_text: That is not the same as controlling it. It was never about controlling it.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一个关键词在两个短句中复沓，第二句把时态推到"从来"完成定音
examples.negative_instruction: 不要复制"控制"这一关键词的用法
